test_title: PYST 69: SSC CGL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Match the following Sportsman in List I and Award in List II:

 
 

 LIST I - Sportsman
 LIST II - Award
 
 
 
 

 A. Devendra Jhajharia
 i. Padma Shri 2022
 
 

 B. Sumit Antil
 ii. Padma Bhushan 2022
 
 

 C. Neeraj Chopra
 iii. Arjun Award 2021
 
 

 D. Shikhar Dhawan
 iv. Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2021
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1: A-ii, B-i, C-iv, D-iii**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Devendra Jhajharia** was awarded the **Padma Bhushan 2022** (A-ii).
 
• **Sumit Antil** received the **Padma Shri 2022** (B-i).
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** was honored with the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2021** (C-iv).
 
• **Shikhar Dhawan** was conferred with the **Arjun Award 2021** (D-iii).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Devendra Jhajharia** is an Indian Paralympic javelin thrower who has won multiple medals in the Paralympic Games. He was awarded the Padma Bhushan in 2022 for his contributions to sports.
 
• **Sumit Antil** is an Indian Paralympic javelin thrower who won a gold medal in the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics. He was awarded the Padma Shri in 2022 for his outstanding performance in sports.
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** is an Indian track and field athlete who competes in the javelin throw. He won a gold medal in the Tokyo 2020 Olympics and was honored with the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in 2021.
 
• **Shikhar Dhawan** is an Indian cricketer and an opening batsman for the Indian national team. He was awarded the Arjun Award in 2021 for his exceptional performance in cricket.
